tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Trisport.ro catalog (Romanian sports retailer: running, cycling, triathlon, swimming, outdoor, sports nutrition, GPS watches). Returns only products that can be bought now, with the current price in RON (VAT included), the old price when discounted, delivery estimate and product URL. IMPO

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: price, discount, description, brand, available sizes with stock and delivery estimate per size, and other colors. Use the returned size product_id when building a cart link.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Products other Trisport customers buy together with this one, and matching accessories. Only buyable items.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Builds a link that opens the customer's cart on trisport.ro with these products already added. Nothing is ordered or paid here: the customer reviews the cart and checks out on the website. For products with sizes, pass the size product_id from get_product.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Contact details, physical store address and links to delivery, returns and warranty policies.

tools.name: get_my_orders
tools.description: Lists the signed-in customer's recent trisport.ro orders with status, total and parcel tracking. Requires the customer to connect their Trisport account.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Status, products and live parcel tracking straight from the courier (current status, latest scan events with location, delivered/returned) for one of the signed-in customer's orders, plus the link to start a return.

tools.name: get_loyalty_points
tools.description: The signed-in customer's Trisport loyalty points: available balance, its value in RON, and points still pending.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Products saved in the signed-in customer's Trisport wishlist, with current price and availability.

tools.name: add_to_wishlist
tools.description: Saves a product to the signed-in customer's Trisport wishlist (visible in their account on trisport.ro).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the Trisport.ro catalog (Romanian sports retailer: running, cycling, triathlon, swimming, outdoor, sports nutrition, GPS watches). Returns only products that can be bought now, with the current price in RON (VAT included), the old price when discounted, delivery estimate and product URL. Quer" → after: "Search the Trisport.ro catalog (Romanian sports retailer: running, cycling, triathlon, swimming, outdoor, sports nutrition, GPS watches). Returns only products that can be bought now, with the current price in RON (VAT included), the old price when discounted, delivery estimate and product URL. IMPO"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
